title: iRacing GT3 Track Guide | Road Atlanta | 2025 Season 3 Week 9

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: 100 meter board, cut over to the outside run off
corners.line: cut over to the outside run off
corners.exit: carry more speed, use less brake
corners.mistakes: leaning on the front left too much

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Break 20-30% on tarmac, not in runoff.
corners.line: Turn in at white line, arc in.
corners.exit: Throttle at curb or marshall hood.
corners.mistakes: Avoid braking in runoff, dip left wheels over grass.

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: lift off at the Marshall hut
corners.line: run wide, avoid the outside curb
corners.mistakes: dipping a wheel, risking spinning off the track

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: lift off at the Marshall hut

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: tiny bit of brake, build brake pressure just before end of curve
corners.line: turn in coming off curb at end of curve, aim central, left wheels on track
corners.exit: slowly bleed off brake, patient on throttle, bounce 60-70%, get on power once steering lock off
corners.mistakes: chase cut over curb, commit to throttle too early on grass/dirt

corners.line: Turn-in on the curb, apex on the top of the dirt, exit on the left side of the track
corners.exit: 75-80% throttle through the curb, 100% throttle off the curb, avoid full throttle on grass
corners.mistakes: Committing to throttle too early, spinning on exit if on grass

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: Commit in deep, brake before curb
corners.line: Turn in deep, aim for blue part of curb
corners.mistakes: Overworking entry or underdoing entry, bouncing on outside curb

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: lift off past orange line, brake softly at 50%
corners.line: angle to hook curb, aim for flat part of curb
corners.exit: come off curb before end, car rotates and bounces
corners.mistakes: commit to curb, hit curb causing bounce into track

corners.label: T5
corners.line: use curb for apex, otherwise stay wide
corners.exit: 100% throttle on exit, aim for outside run off
corners.mistakes: bouncing off curb costs exit position

corners.label: T6
corners.gear: late downshift between second and third set of lines
corners.line: get nice and close to inside curb, touch orange line
corners.mistakes: overwork braking, over-push entry, go wide onto grass

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: break a nice straight line, 65 70% brake
corners.line: follow the curb, turn-in towards the end of the curb
corners.exit: slow release the brakes, trail brake 40 50% to 20%
corners.mistakes: overshoot the entry to the apex

corners.braking: Left wheels on curb, brake early, 40-50% to 20%
corners.line: Cut over the curb, mid-corner throttle 60-70%
corners.exit: 100% throttle, let car run wide, avoid fighting the car
corners.mistakes: Too aggressive on initial power, fighting the car

corners.line: Keep car right, use outside curb as reference
corners.mistakes: Drifting left, lifting off too early in traffic

corners.braking: Build up to 100% brake just before the outside curb
corners.line: Turn-in at curb, apex at curb, cut inside on exit
corners.exit: Release brakes over crest, use right wheels on white line
corners.mistakes: Don't smash the brake, build up gradually

corners.label: T1
corners.line: Cut inside curb, aim for left part of curb, half car over line.
corners.exit: 100% throttle after settling from curb bounce.
corners.mistakes: Wiggling here loses time to line, aggressive throttle can cause car to snap around.

general_tips: be wary of dirt on the way in with people going over the grass
stay over the white line in the race
cut over the outside run off on a hotlap
avoid sending the car too hard into turn one
two lines here and then a third line here
braking line, turning in line, downshift line
on throttle very very early here
wait on the throttle a little bit in the long run
get off the throttle on the brakes as soon as you get on the curb
Be patient on throttle after the wiggle to avoid slipping and sliding.
